question: By what means does the speaker come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of the Kaulas.
The speaker has come to know something.
That knowledge arises by the grace of the addressee.
What is known is the determination of the Kaula teaching.
inference: The determination of the Kaula teaching is known to the speaker solely by the addressee's grace.
uncertainties: The prior state of ignorance is implied but not detailed.
plain_english: By your grace, O lord of the Kaulas, I have come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching.
